summary.description: Concise Markdown summary of the PR review and any residual test risk

comments.description: Confirmed findings to publish as inline review comments, ordered by severity

path.description: Exact repository-relative path from the PR diff

start_line.description: First right-side line in the diff range

line.description: Last right-side line in the diff range

body.description: Actionable Markdown finding with impact and a concrete fix

has_suggestion.description: Whether suggestion is an exact replacement for the selected range

suggestion.description: Exact replacement text without Markdown fences; empty when has_suggestion is false
